title: A Shape on the Road
body:
It comes out of the ditch grass without any noise at all, which is the part that stays with you. One animal, ribs like a washboard, eyes doing the arithmetic wolves do.

There is no treeline to threaten it back into. There is no coin worth throwing. It has already decided, and now so must you.

choices.label: Meet it.
choices.hint: There is not going to be a clean way out of this one.

outcomes.text: It closes the distance before you have finished the thought.
